name: zclass_node_set_priority
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeSetPriority changes a callback node priority and requeues active callback-list membership.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?gwNodeSetPriority@zClass_Class@@YIHPAUzClass_NodePartial@@H@Z at 0x448090 currently fails with 72 unmasked mismatches after masking 20 relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 98 bytes, the VC object symbol is 96 bytes with 1 trailing VC NOP byte trimmed, and the triage artifact is build/vc5-verify/zclass_node_set_priority/verify/448090_byte_triage.txt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x448090 validates null-node return 5, removal from the old priority bucket only when the node has an action callback and old priority is 0 through 5, insertion into the new bucket only for priorities 0 through 5, priority field update, and success return 0.
The native smoke verifies callback-list requeueing from priority 1 to 2, deferred removal of the old bucket, invalid priority storage without insertion, and null-node handling.
